o.text:
From Proto-Common Turkic [Term?].
cognates
Cognate with Turkish soy.
From Proto-Turkic *kȫŕ (“glowing coals”). Akin to qor (“ember”). Cognate with Turkish köz.
Inherited from Proto-Common Turkic *aydïŋ (“light”); see cognates at Ottoman Turkish آیدین (aydın). The sense 'intellectual' is a semantic loan from Turkish aydın.
From Armenian հոտաղ (hotaġ). Cognate with Turkish hodak.
